title: Real Málaga geography
description: The live simulator now runs over a real OpenStreetMap view of Málaga and Montes de Málaga. k-median is recomputed in geodesic kilometres; incidents and bases remain explicitly synthetic while Las Contadoras provides an official geographic anchor.

title: Live reproducible simulator
description: Seeded incident generation, animated resource movement and live comparison between EcoDispatch, nearest-feasible greedy and an exact finite offline optimum computed by dynamic programming.

title: Mathematical core + first visual dashboard
description: First integrated prototype: exact small-instance risk-weighted k-median, lexicographic feasible dispatch, offline k-server benchmark and a public dashboard prepared for visual experiment tracking.
